column1: Yandy Diaz leads the slate with a strong hit probability and over 70% of games with a hit, benefiting from a favorable park and batting leadoff against Tomoyuki Sugano. Jonathan Aranda offers nearly identical upside with a slight platoon advantage and a recent uptick in hit rate, making him a reliable secondary pick. Jake McCarthy and Junior Caminero are also in good spots, but Diaz’s combination of consistency and matchup stands out for Beat The Streak.
